content.text:
Checked it — it does not parse, and I did **not** save it or touch the default template. **The error:** `Unclosed {{#each lines}}` — a loop that never ends. **What's wrong in plain language:** Your snippet opens a repeat block with `{{#each lines}}` — "for every line on the invoice, print this" — but it never closes it. The template language requires a matching `{{/each}}` to mark where the repeat stops. Because the closing tag is missing, the renderer can't tell where the loop body ends, so it refuses to parse the whole template. The `` tags don't help; `{{/each}}` is a separate thing from HTML closing tags. **The fix** is simply to close the loop before ``: ``` {{#each lines}}

{{description}}

{{/each}} ``` Two things worth knowing if you go on to build this into a real invoice: - `{{description}}` is a valid line field, so that part is fine — it prints each line's description (escaped, so it's safe). - As written, the loop has no surrounding invoice structure. A working invoice template also needs the company legal name and reg no, the customer block, document number/date, the line table, the tax breakdown and the total — the legally useful parts. I'd start from your existing Standard invoice and edit that rather than pasting a bare snippet. If you want, paste the full edited template (with the `{{/each}}` added) and I'll render a preview for you and flag any variables that would print empty. Say the word and I can also save it as a new version — but I'll wait for your approval before changing anything.
